description: This file defines a class CheckResponsesCost responsible for polling and checking the cost of responses in the LiteLLM system. It interacts with a database through PrismaClient, verifies response statuses via litellm.aget_responses(), and updates response statuses accordingly. It is part of a larger infrastructure for managing and tracking LLM response costs in an enterprise context.

classes.name: CheckResponsesCost
classes.description: A class tasked with polling response jobs, checking their completion status, and updating their cost tracking in the database.

methods.name: __init__( self, proxy_logging_obj: "ProxyLogging", prisma_client: "PrismaClient", llm_router: "Router", )
methods.description: Constructor that initializes dependencies such as logging, Prisma client, and LLM router.

methods.name: check_responses_cost(self)
methods.description: Asynchronously checks queued or in-progress response jobs, queries response status, and marks jobs as complete or failed in the database.
